name: Cbl proto-oncogene B

function.text: CBLB encodes E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase CBL-B. Annotated molecular activities include ubiquitin protein ligase activity and calcium ion binding. It participates in signal transduction and protein stabilization.

germline.text: The reviewed GenCC assertions do not establish a conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship for this draft; limited or conflicting assertions require separate review.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Lung Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
